articles.title: How to make a purchase order
articles.summary: Make a purchase order in Nivesh Sahayak: vendor, their quotation number, delivery date, items and rates, terms; then check the supplier bill in the App.

articles.title: How purchase order numbers work
articles.summary: How purchase order numbers work in Nivesh Sahayak: PO series per business, restart every 1 April, change the prefix, and fix a duplicate number.

articles.title: Print, PDF and share a purchase order
articles.summary: Print a purchase order on A4, A5 or a thermal roll, pick one of 7 designs and copies, save a PDF, or share it on WhatsApp from Nivesh Sahayak.

articles.title: Saved purchase orders: find, open, copy and edit
articles.card: Saved purchase orders: open, copy, edit
articles.summary: Find any saved purchase order in Nivesh Sahayak: search the Saved purchase orders list, open to edit or reprint, copy it as new, set its status.
